MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The small imperial screws and metric flat-head assortment support my ongoing fastening work while adding thread sizes or flush-mount options beyond the hardware I already have.",
    "The clamp meter fits my interest in practical inspection and measurement for repairs, and disposable gloves would help with messy workshop cleanup."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Another borescope offers little clear benefit when I already have a triple-lens camera with a larger screen; a similar tool is not automatically something I need again.",
    "The six-inch cutting wheels differ from my recent five-inch wheels, so their usefulness depends on tool compatibility. The breadboards and sound meter also lack a current project to justify buying them.",
    "The face masks and automatic bathroom bin do not address the fastening, fabrication, or repair supplies I am looking for now."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in measuring and inspection tools seems to have been stretched into an interest in any measuring device, even without a specific task.",
    "Having bought a tool or consumable seems to be treated as a reason to buy another similar one, without enough attention to duplication or differences in size."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Compatibility matters: wheel diameter, screw thread, and head shape can determine whether an otherwise relevant item is useful to me.",
    "My repeated hardware purchases suggest ongoing assembly work, where complementary fasteners can be useful, while durable tools need a clearer new capability to justify another purchase.",
    "Workshop supplies need to suit the actual job; for example, I would check glove chemical compatibility before using them with epoxy."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my repair and fabrication interests but sometimes overlook compatibility, tools I already own, and whether I have a current use for an item."
}
